draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 226th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 10th of 12 at TE. He went 206th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 148 receiving yards in 2019, 10th of 12 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 39 career games and 1 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 0 AV in 2020. Weak spots: receiving yards 26 (8th percentile), approximate value 0 (9th percentile).
